review_candidates.title: SC Planning Master Data Associate Analyst
review_candidates.description: Overview The Master Data Analyst is responsible for creating, correcting and maintaining supply chain master data required to execute end-to-end supply planning activities. The role ensures that all materials, BOMs, routings, sourcing rules, lead times and planning parameters are correct, complete and available on time in the relevant planning systems to facilitate supply planning processes. Reporting to the Category Supply Planner, this role acts as the data integrity owner and collaborates cross-functionally to ensure timely receipt of inputs required to maintain master data, and resolve issues which risk service, inventory, cost or feasibility. Responsibilities Creates and maintains accurate, timely supply‑planning master data (incl. materials, BOMs, routings, sourcing, lead times, capacities) to enable feasible category supply plans Works in close partnership with peers (other Master Data, Category SPs, etc.) across OUs where necessary to ensure correct, complete master data for inter-company products/materials Performs routine master data audits to ensure accuracy, completeness, and alignment with planning rules, data templates, and global standards Troubleshoots data issues, investigates deviations, and collaborates with requesters to resolve inconsistencies or unclear change requests Provides planning teams with clear data inputs that enable scenario modelling, sourcing decisions, and capacity evaluations Collaborates with the Planning Digital Innovator to identify opportunities to automate, streamline, or enhance master data processes, ensuring increased accuracy and reduced cycle times Supports the development and implementation of data governance standards, standard operating procedures, templates, and controls across the planning ecosystem Trains and mentors planning and Market colleagues on master data best practices to build data literacy across the Forecast to Schedule competency Track and periodically report performance management on data requests that will enable continuous improvement in data quality Parameter Optimization: Monitor and maintain optimal planning parameters in planning systems, and identify when parameters need review Reporting activities: Dashboard of relevant data to conduct ad hoc analysis Qualifications Target years’ experience: 2 to 3 years Master Data Lifecycle Management 2 Data Standards and Compliance 2 Bulk Data Management and Upload 2 Analytical Problem Solving 2 BOM/Routing/Resource Understanding 2 Proficiency level: 1 Foundational, 2 Proficient, 3 Expert

review_candidates.title: Treasury and Accounting Officer
review_candidates.description: Apply now » Date: 16 Sept 2026 Location: Makati City, Philippines Company: Plan International The Organisation Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child but know this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And it is girls who are most affected. Working together with children, young people, supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges girls and vulnerable children face. We support children’s rights from birth until they reach adulthood and we enable children to prepare for and respond to crises and adversity. We drive changes in practice and policy at local, national and global levels using our reach, experience and knowledge. For over 85 years, we have rallied other determined optimists to transform the lives of all children in more than 80 countries. We won’t stop until we are all equal. Make an Impact Through Finance Are you a finance and accounting professional who wants to contribute to meaningful development work? We are looking for a Treasury and Accounting Officer who will play a vital role in ensuring the efficient management of funds, accurate financial reporting, and effective treasury operations that support programs and projects across the country. This role is ideal for professionals with experience in accounting, treasury management, and financial operations, particularly those who have worked with NGOs, donor-funded projects, or development organizations. What You'll Do As Treasury and Accounting Officer, you will provide financial and operational support by ensuring timely fund transfers, maintaining accurate accounting records, and supporting treasury and compliance functions. Accounting and Financial Management Process and oversee accounts payable transactions from invoice processing to payment release. Review and authorize invoices with identified discrepancies for resolution and payment. Prepare and post journal entries, including month-end accruals. Manage fixed asset records, including asset creation, updates, and maintenance. Ensure all transactions are accurately recorded in SAP within the correct accounting period. Classify financial transactions according to the approved chart of accounts. Maintain accounting records and support financial reporting requirements. Treasury and Banking Operations Consolidate and monitor bank reports. Ensure timely completion and submission of banking requirements and documentation. Manage electronic banking access, including user applications, updates, and deactivation. Prepare and submit required government remittance forms and related documentation. Cash Flow and Fund Management Consolidate projected cash inflows and outflows from various projects and departments. Coordinate closely with program teams, budget holders, grants, and finance stakeholders to gather funding and expenditure forecasts. Prepare fund requests and support cash flow planning and forecasting activities. Assist in ensuring sufficient liquidity for program and operational requirements. Qualifications What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. At least 2-3 years of relevant professional experience in accounting, treasury, or financial management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Solid understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, and reporting processes. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting systems; experience with SAP is highly desirable. Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail. Effective communication skills and the ability to explain financial concepts to non-finance colleagues. Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities. Preferred Experience Experience working with NGOs, international development organizations, or donor-funded projects. Knowledge of project accounting, grants management, and compliance requirements. Familiarity with treasury operations and cash flow forecasting. Other Requirements Demonstrated integrity, accountability, and professionalism. Willingness to conduct field visits to project areas when required. Must be a Filipino national based in the Philippines. Why Join Us? By joining our team, you will contribute to programs that create positive change in communities while continuing to build your expertise in finance, treasury, and development-sector operations. You will work with dedicated professionals committed to accountability, stewardship, and impact. Apply Now If you are a detail-oriented finance professional who is passionate about supporting development work through strong financial management, we encourage you to apply. Be part of a team where your financial expertise helps deliver lasting impact. Location: Country Office (Makati City), Metro Manila Type of Role: Regular, open-ended Reports to: Finance and Accounting Operations Manager Hybrid working arrangements Competitive Compensation Package (local T&C) Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the very heart of everything that Plan International stands for. We want Plan International to reflect the diversity of the communities we work with, offering equal opportunities to everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. Plan International is based on a culture of inclusivity and we strive to create a workplace environment that ensures every team, in every office, in every country, is rich in diverse people, thoughts, and ideas. We foster an organisational culture that embraces our commitment to racial justice, gender equality, girls’ rights and inclusion. Plan International believes that in a world where children face so many threats of harm, it is our duty to ensure that we, as an organisation, do everything we can to keep children safe. This means that we have particular responsibilities to children that we come into contact with and we must not contribute in any way to harming or placing children at risk. A range of pre-employment checks will be undertaken in conformity with Plan International's Safeguarding Children and Young People policy. Plan International also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this scheme we will request information from applicants previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures. Please note that Plan International will never send unsolicited emails requesting payment from candidates. Apply now »

review_candidates.title: Systemingenjör inom fordonsutveckling
review_candidates.description: Bli en del av vårt team och utveckla framtidens uppkopplade fordon! QRTECH befinner sig i en stark tillväxtfas och söker nu en systemingenjör som vill vara med och utveckla avancerade lösningar inom fordonsindustrin. Vi är ett teknikdrivet ingenjörshus i Mölndal/Göteborg som utvecklar elektronik och mjukvara åt kunder inom flera högteknologiska branscher – från innovativa startups till globala industriföretag. Hos oss får du arbeta med tekniskt utmanande projekt tillsammans med erfarna ingenjörer inom bland annat embedded, elektronik och systemutveckling. Projekten drivs antingen in-house i våra lokaler i Mölndal/Göteborg eller på plats hos kund, vilket ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas i olika tekniska miljöer och sammanhang. Om rollen Som systemingenjör hos QRTECH arbetar du med systemdesign och funktionsutveckling inom fordonsindustrin. Du får en central roll i att omsätta funktionella behov och krav till välfungerande tekniska lösningar och arbetar nära både interna utvecklingsteam, kunder och externa leverantörer.
